title: John F. Slater Memorial Museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: It’s 1923, and the Slater Memorial Museum is pleased to invite you to the opening of its newest exhibition, “Murder on Exhibit: Treasures from the Tombs,” featuring recently acquired artifacts from the Valley of the Kings. These royal relics are sure to delight artists, historians and Egyptomaniacs alike, but is someone prepared to kill for them? Join such Norwich luminaries as the Slater family, staff of the Norwich Art School and Abraham Lincoln’s granddaughter as you solve a murder at the museum! Hosted by the Friends of Slater, this special event will feature the Dirty Blue Shirts, a group of living historians! Ticket price includes a full spread of hot and cold offerings by Chef Kim,

blurb: Located on the campus of Norwich Free Academy, the Slater Museum awakens visitors to the richness and diversity of the human experience through art and history.
